causalEvidence.B386: Twelve source cases fail before the fix. A private old compiled service, loaded through a copied local provider with only its service import redirected, physically creates Node processes and PTYs in all 8 withdrawn/replaced owner cases. The updated Loader transcript refuses all 8, releases the original grant once and never acquires replacement capacity; unchanged owners still create their targets.
causalEvidence.B387: Fresh isolated processes expose one exit callback immediately after old source or built output import, including caller-owned storage. Both outcomes fail before the fix and pass after it: import/custom directory add 0 callbacks, repeated default allocation adds 1, actual exit removes an empty directory and preserves completed output. Trace evidence identifies the default-spill callback, not a Local provider unload leak; a three-iteration ordinary provider probe returns exit listeners to baseline after each fiber disposal.
